rows.english: S = sow seed (in trays for transplant crops). T = check seedlings; transplant when ready. Check water and field conditions before planting.
rows.zu: S = hlwanyela imbewu (emathreyini ezitshalo ezizotshalwa kwenye indawo). T = hlola izithombo; zitshale uma sezilungile. Hlola amanzi nezimo zensimu ngaphambi kokutshala.
rows.st: S = jala peo (ditereing bakeng sa dijalo tse tla fallisetswa tshimong). T = hlahloba dipeo tse metseng; di fallisetse tshimong ha di se di loketse. Hlahloba metsi le maemo a tshimo pele o lema.
rows.ts: S = byala mbewu (eka thireyi ta swibyariwa leswi nga ta yisiwa ensin'wini). T = kambela swimilana; swi yise ensin'wini loko swi lunghekile. Kambela mati ni swiyimo swa nsimu u nga si byala.
rows.ve: S = zwalani mbeu (kha thirei dza zwimela zwine zwa ḓo sudzuluselwa tsimuni). T = sedzulusani zwimelana; zwi sudzuluseleni tsimuni musi zwo no luga. Sedzulusani maḓi na nyimele dza tsimu phanḓa ha u ṱavha.

rows.english: Bed allocations, varieties, seed buying and monthly jobs are in the separate crop-plan report. This calendar shows planned starts, not confirmation of planting.
rows.zu: Ukwabiwa kwemibhede, izinhlobo ezikhethiwe, ukuthengwa kwembewu nemisebenzi yenyanga kusembikweni ohlukile wohlelo lwezitshalo. Leli khalenda libonisa ukuqala okuhleliwe, hhayi ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi kutshaliwe.
rows.st: Dikabo tsa dibethe, mefuta e kgethilweng, ho reka peo le mesebetsi ya kgwedi di tlalehong e arohaneng ya moralo wa dijalo. Khalendara ena e bontsha diqalo tse rerilweng, eseng netefatso ya hore ho jetswe.
rows.ts: Swiphemu swa mibedo, tinxaka leti hlawuriweke, ku xava mbewu ni mintirho ya n’hweti swi le ka xiviko lexi hambaneke xa pulani ya swibyariwa. Khalendara leyi yi komba masungulo lama pulaniweke, a yi tiyisisi leswaku ku byariwile.
rows.ve: Zwavhelo zwa mibete, tshaka dzo nangwaho, u renga mbeu na mishumo ya ṅwedzi zwi kha muvhigo wo fhambanaho wa pulane ya zwiliṅwa. Khalenda iyi i sumbedza mathomo o pulaniwaho, a i khwaṱhisedzi uri ho ṱavhiwa.
